shots.say: Look! An egg is wobbling! Who is inside?
Three eggs, and three mystery babies! Let's find out whose eggs they are.
I'm Milo the bluebird. Let's play Guess With Milo!
The Animated Zoo!
Look closely at each egg, and say your guess. Ready? Let's play!
Here is the first egg. It is so big! It sits in a hole, in the dirt. Whose egg is it?
Is it the ostrich's egg? Or is it the duck's egg?
It is the ostrich!
Here is the fun fact. The ostrich is the biggest bird in the world!
And it lays the biggest egg, of all!
One ostrich egg is as heavy as about twenty-four chicken eggs!
The dad scratches the nest, in the dirt. It is just a shallow hole!
Who keeps the egg warm?
Mom sits on the eggs in the day. And dad sits on them at night!
Can you sit like an ostrich, on a big egg? Gently, gently!
Listen! Tap, tap. Crack! Here comes the chick!
The chick is about as big as a chicken!
A few days later, the chicks walk with mom and dad.
Say it with me. The ostrich lays the biggest egg!
An ostrich can't fly. But it can run very fast! Zoom!
Run in place, like a fast ostrich! Run, run, run!
Quick check! Is an ostrich egg big, or small?
Big! Great job!
Here are more eggs. Lots of little round eggs, in the sand! Whose eggs are they?
Are they the sea turtle's eggs? Or are they the frog's eggs?
It is the sea turtle!
Here is the fun fact. A mama sea turtle crawls up the sandy beach.
She digs a hole in the sand, with her flippers. Dig, dig!
She lays about one hundred eggs! So many!
Each egg is about as big as a ping-pong ball.
The eggs are soft, and leathery. They dent, instead of breaking!
Then she covers the eggs with sand, and goes back to the sea.
When do the babies come out?
Mostly at night, the babies hatch. And they all hurry to the sea, together!
Crawl like a baby sea turtle! Flap your flippers. Flap, flap!
Say it with me. A sea turtle lays her eggs in the sand!
shots.tag: say it: eggs in the sand

shots.say: Now dig in the sand, like a mama sea turtle. Dig, dig, dig!
Quick check! Where does a sea turtle lay her eggs? In the sand, or in a tree?
In the sand! Super digging!
Here is the last egg. It is not in a nest at all! It is on somebody's feet! Whose egg is it?
Is it the penguin's egg? Or is it the owl's egg?
It is the emperor penguin!
Here is the fun fact. Penguins do not build nests.
The mama penguin lays one egg. Then the daddy keeps it, on his feet!
shots.tag: daddy keeps it on his feet

shots.say: He covers it with a warm fold of feathered skin. It is called a brood pouch!
So cozy! Penguins huddle close together, to stay warm.
Can you balance an egg on your feet? Shuffle, shuffle, slowly!
Where is the mama penguin?
She is fishing in the sea! After about two months, she comes back, with food.
The chick hatches. And mama keeps it warm, in her cozy pouch!
Say it with me. The daddy penguin keeps the egg on his feet!
Waddle like a penguin! Left, right, left, right!
Quick check! Where does the daddy penguin keep the egg? On his feet, or on his head?
On his feet! You remembered!
Three eggs, and three families! Now it is quiz time!
Who lays the biggest egg of all? The ostrich, or the penguin?
The ostrich! Its egg is so big!
Who digs a nest in the sand? The sea turtle, or the ostrich?
The sea turtle! Dig, dig!
Who keeps an egg on his feet? The ostrich, or the penguin?
The penguin! Warm and cozy.
Look at all the babies, safe with their families! You guessed them all!
Stand tall like an ostrich. Dig like a sea turtle. And shuffle, shuffle, like a penguin!
Next time on Guess With Milo, a brand new mystery! Bye-bye, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
